_comment: Goat & Co. internal wiki, as seeded on startup and restored by reset. Fictional. The first line of each page is its ground truth.

pages.expenses:
Expense reports must be filed within 30 days and need manager approval before reimbursement.
Attach itemised receipts for every expense report claim over 25 dollars.
pages.travel:
Business travel must be booked through the travel desk at least 14 days in advance.
Economy class is the default for flights under six hours.
pages.payroll:
Payroll runs on the last business day of each month; changes must reach HR by the 20th.
Payslips are available in the HR portal.
pages.holidays: Company holidays: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Winter Break from Dec 24 to Jan 1.
pages.vpn: Remote VPN access requires a company laptop and multi-factor authentication; request it through the IT service desk.
